user_stories.title: Add helper function to get repository slug from git remote
acceptance_criteria: Function getRepoSlug(root: string) returns repository slug (e.g., 'user/repo')
Function parses 'git remote get-url origin' output
Function handles both HTTPS URLs (https://github.com/owner/repo.git)
Function handles SSH URLs (git@github.com:owner/repo.git)
Function returns null if git command fails or URL doesn't match github.com pattern
Function is exported from src/git/remote.ts (create file if not exists)
Function uses spawn() from 'node:child_process' for git command execution
Function handles git process errors gracefully
user_stories.notes: This is a helper function needed by all CLI commands to filter sessions by repository. Check if src/git/remote.ts exists first - if not, create it. The regex pattern is: /github\.com[:/]([^/]+\/[^/]+?)(\.git)?$/

user_stories.title: Add CLI command for listing Fly.io Sprite sessions
acceptance_criteria: Command 'wreckit compute sprite status' displays all Sprite sessions for current repository
Output includes: itemId, spriteId, status, createdAt, lastAccessedAt for each session
Command filters sessions by current repository slug using getRepoSlug()
Command supports '--json' flag for programmatic output
Command displays appropriate error when Sprites backend is not enabled
Command displays 'No Sprite sessions for this repository' when none exist
JSON output is valid and parseable with success, message, and data fields
Non-JSON output is human-readable with emoji indicators (📋, ✅, ❌)
Command validates config.compute.backend === 'sprites' before running
user_stories.notes: Create src/commands/computeSprite.ts with computeSpriteStatusCommand() function. Use existing SpriteSessionStore.list() method and filter by repoSlug. Register command in src/index.ts under 'wreckit compute sprite' namespace to distinguish from existing Wisp CLI commands.

user_stories.title: Add CLI command for resuming paused Sprite sessions
acceptance_criteria: Command 'wreckit compute sprite resume <itemId>' changes session status to 'active'
Command updates lastAccessedAt timestamp to current time
Command requires Sprites backend to be enabled (validates config)
Command displays error if session not found for current repository
Command displays error if session already active (unless --force flag used)
Command supports '--json' flag for programmatic output
Command supports '--force' flag to resume active sessions
Success message includes itemId, spriteId, and new status
Command uses SpriteSessionStore.get() and save() methods
user_stories.notes: Add computeSpriteResumeCommand() function to src/commands/computeSprite.ts. This only updates session status - it doesn't actually run the sprite. The resume logic for reusing sprites during execution is already implemented in SpritesBackend.ensureSprite().

user_stories.title: Add CLI command for destroying Sprite sessions
acceptance_criteria: Command 'wreckit compute sprite destroy <itemId>' deletes the Fly.io Sprite VM
Command removes the session file from .wreckit/sessions/
Command loads SPRITE_TOKEN from environment or .wreckit/.sprite.env using loadSpriteEnv()
Command validates required tokens using validateSpriteEnv() before proceeding
Command requires Sprites backend to be enabled (validates config)
Command displays error if session not found for current repository
Command displays error if session still active (unless --force flag used)
Command supports '--json' flag for programmatic output
Command supports '--force' flag to destroy active sessions
Command handles Sprite deletion errors gracefully (deletes session file anyway)
Command uses SpritesClient from @fly/sprites SDK directly
user_stories.notes: Add computeSpriteDestroyCommand() function to src/commands/computeSprite.ts. The destroy logic is similar to SpritesBackend.cleanup() but callable from CLI. Must import SpritesClient and use client.deleteSprite(spriteId) method.

user_stories.title: Register new CLI commands in index.ts
acceptance_criteria: New command group 'wreckit compute' exists in CLI
Subcommand 'wreckit compute sprite' exists with description 'Manage Fly.io Sprite sessions'
All three commands (status, resume, destroy) are registered under compute sprite
Commands use executeCommand() wrapper for error handling
Commands support global options (--verbose, --quiet, --dry-run, --cwd)
Commands use dynamic imports (await import(...)) for lazy loading
Commands are registered after existing sprite commands (after line 655 in src/index.ts)
Command descriptions are clear and accurate
Commands follow the same pattern as existing sprite commands
user_stories.notes: Follow the existing pattern for spriteCmd registration but create computeCmd and computeSpriteCmd to keep namespaces separate. This avoids confusion between Wisp CLI commands (wreckit sprite) and Fly.io Sprites commands (wreckit compute sprite).

user_stories.title: Add iteration counter to SpritesBackend
acceptance_criteria: SpritesBackend has private field 'iterationCount' initialized to 0
runIteration() method increments iterationCount for each call
runIteration() resets iterationCount to 0 when switching to different itemId
runIteration() yields error event if iterationCount > limits.max_iterations
Error message includes iteration count and limit value (e.g., 'Iteration limit exceeded: 4 > 3')
Error event has type: 'error' and includes timestamp
cleanup() method resets iterationCount to 0
Iteration counter persists across multiple runIteration() calls for same itemId
Limit check happens early in runIteration() before calling ensureSprite()
user_stories.notes: Add 'private iterationCount = 0;' field to SpritesBackend class alongside existing fields (activeSprite, currentItemId, succeeded). The check should happen at the start of runIteration() to avoid creating sprites if limit already exceeded.
